a: Every learner in the batch. Miles are added automatically when you attend or submit, so there's nothing to sign up for.

q: Do Miles from before the launch count?
a: Yes. Miles are calculated from your very first session, so everything you've done so far is already on your dashboard.

q: Do I need to do anything to start earning?
a: No. Keep attending lectures and submitting your work. Your Miles are calculated and added for you.
Yes. Watching a recording earns 150 Miles for a mandatory lecture and 100 Miles for a non-mandatory one. Attending live earns 50 more.

q: If I attend live and also watch the recording, do I earn twice?
a: No. Each lecture earns Miles once, at the higher live rate if you attended live. Rewatching is still a great way to revise.

q: Does my score change the Miles I get?
a: No. Miles are for submitting assignments and taking evaluations, whatever your score.

q: What counts towards the 100 Miles a week?
a: Every Mile you earn that week from lectures, assignments and evaluations. One live mandatory lecture (200 Miles) is enough on its own.

q: When does a streak week start and end?
a: A streak week runs Monday to Sunday. Earn 100 or more Miles by Sunday night to keep your streak going.

q: What happens if I miss a week?
a: Your multiplier goes back to 1.0x and the streak starts again. Miles you've already earned are never taken away.

q: Is there a limit to the multiplier?
a: Yes. It rises by 0.1x each week and is capped at 1.5x from Week 5. Keep your streak going to stay at 1.5x.

q: Where can I see my Miles?
a: On your Miles dashboard. Your Program Coordinator (PC) will share the link with you.

q: How often is the dashboard updated?
a: Every day, so Miles for today's lectures and submissions show up by the next day.

q: How do I redeem a reward?
a: Choose a reward on your dashboard and redeem it there. The Miles are deducted from your balance and the team reaches out to schedule or activate your reward.

q: I can't open my dashboard. What should I do?
a: Sign in with your registered Masai email ID. If it still doesn't open, reach out to your PC.

q: Can I convert or transfer Miles?
a: No. Miles can only be spent on rewards in the Miles rewards store. They can't be exchanged for cash or given to another learner.

q: Do Miles affect my grades or placements?
a: No. Miles reward your engagement and are separate from your grades, evaluations and placement process.

q: Who do I ask if my Miles look wrong?
a: Reach out to your PC or raise a ticket from the Miles dashboard with the activity and the date, and they'll look into it.
